notices.title: Blood of Dawnwalker Dev Issues Official Statement on PC Issues
notices.contentSnippet: Despite a well received launch, The Blood of Dawnwalker features performance issues on PC, with Rebel Wolves offering workarounds for those impacted.

notices.title: Predicting the MAJOR Zelda & Switch 2 Reveals at Both Nintendo Directs
notices.contentSnippet: Nintendo is showing up big time for Switch 2 players with two full Nintendo Direct presentations set for September 8th and 9th. First we get a 40th Anniversary blowout for The Legend of Zelda that is sure to give us a look at the Ocarina of Time remake and many more Zelda reveals. Then, Nintendo has their expected general direct that could have massive new reveals in several Nintendo franchises from Metroid to Mario!
